title: More Information
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM
You define TOU exception programs in Customizing in the activity Define Time-of-Use Exception Program.

Choose one of the following paths in SAP Customizing:

¢ |}SAP Utilities > Contract Billing > Billing Master Data AMI: Time-of-Use Interface > Define Time-of-Use Exception
Program 3.

e |PSAP Utilities >} Advanced Metering Infrastructure > Time-of-Use Interface > Define Time-of-Use Exception Program 9

More Information

For concept information, see Time-of-Use Exception Program

For application information, see the documentation for the Customizing activity and the field help (F1).

Create Billing Schema Extension

Use

You define a billing schema extension to perform conditional billing. You do this from a billing schema.

To create a schema extension, proceed as follows:

1. Select the Execute Conditional Billing Program indicator in the schema.
2. From the schema header, choose Schema Steps or the following menu path |}»Goto » Schema Steps 9.

3. From the schema steps, choose Schema Extension or the following menu path |)»Goto » Schema Extension ¥.

More Information

For more information about the billing schema extension concept, see

Billing Schema Extension

Activities in Production Operation

You monitor and edit TOU exceptions and the associated TOU exception responses on a daily basis. You can use the following
transactions to do so, for which more information is available from the respective link below:

e Monitor and Edit Time-of-Use Exceptions

e Monitor and Edit Time-of-Use Exception Responses

To reduce your database load, you can archive TOU exceptions and exception responses.

Monitor and Edit Time-of-Use Exceptions
